last_food_time.evidence_quote: Have your last solid food by 9am on Tuesday 3 November 2026

last_clear_fluids_time.evidence_quote: You can keep drinking clear fluids (water, squash, black tea) until 11am on the day of your appointment.

bowel_preparation_required.evidence_quote: Follow a low-fibre diet for 2 days before your appointment. Have your last solid food by 9am on Tuesday 3 November 2026. After that, take the bowel preparation as described on the separate sheet and drink clear fluids only.

(cid:127) Passing more than a small amount of blood
(cid:127) A high temperature
